follow-a-request-end-to-end.title: Follow a request end to end
follow-a-request-end-to-end.description: Follow one request like a parcel through several stations. Predict its waits before you compare your plan with the recorded run.
follow-a-request-end-to-end.html:
Follow one request like a parcel through several stations. Predict its waits before you compare your plan with the recorded run.

  • Predict where main will wait before you press play
  • Find the GC step and say what it frees
  • Compare your prediction with the run, step by step

tune-the-allocator.title: Tune the allocator
tune-the-allocator.description: Tune a packing line by preparing enough space before work starts. Compare allocation counts for equal work and keep the smaller number without changing the…
tune-the-allocator.html:
Tune a packing line by preparing enough space before work starts. Compare allocation counts for equal work and keep the smaller number without changing the answer.

  • Say why make([]int,0,8) avoids extra allocations
  • Count the backing arrays that appear when append runs out of room

race-and-deadlock-gauntlet.title: Race and deadlock gauntlet
race-and-deadlock-gauntlet.description: The gauntlet is a set of traffic puzzles with more than one failure mode. Repair a rule, rerun, and check both race evidence and whether work can finish.
race-and-deadlock-gauntlet.html:
The gauntlet is a set of traffic puzzles with more than one failure mode. Repair a rule, rerun, and check both race evidence and whether work can finish.

  • Say why the mutex removes the race but cannot prevent a deadlock
  • Explain what happens if wg.Add says 3 but only 2 goroutines run
  • Check both things: no race, and every goroutine finishes

build-a-cancellable-pipeline.title: Build a cancellable pipeline
build-a-cancellable-pipeline.description: Build a pipeline with a clear stop signal at every station. Cancel it and verify that no station is left waiting for a parcel that will never arrive.
build-a-cancellable-pipeline.html:
Build a pipeline with a clear stop signal at every station. Cancel it and verify that no station is left waiting for a parcel that will never arrive.

  • Say how one cancel() stops every worker listening on ctx
  • Check that no worker goroutine is still waiting at the end
  • Explain why a printed result does not prove the workers exited
